quote: REG is also one of the typical tasks in NLPas-Science, where REG algorithms are built to model and explain the reference production of human beings.

... REG-in-context is often approached ... The main task was to predict the referential form, namely whether to use a pronoun, proper name, description or an empty reference at a given point in discourse ...

REG can be divided into two distinct tasks: one-shot REG, finding a referring expression (RE) to single out a referent from a set, and REG-in-context, generating an RE to refer to a referent at a given point in a discourse.
datasets: Wall Street Journal (WSJ) portion of OntoNotes
outputs: referring expressions (REs) classified as pronoun, description, or proper name
Predicted referential form (pronoun, description, proper name) for each mention
